title: Playing With Both Hands
body: The hardest part of piano isn't learning the notes — it's making both hands work independently. Start slow. The left hand holds the harmony while the right hand carries the melody.

title: Grand Staff
caption: When both hands are written together, it's called a grand staff. The top staff (treble clef) is the right hand; the bottom (bass clef) is the left. The brace on the left ties them together.
